0022600137.text: The Bulls (1-3) host the Knicks (1-3) in the fifth game of Chicago's season, with the Bulls on a two-game losing streak, 11th in the East and 4th in the Central, 2 games back, and 0-1 at home. New York is 12th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, also 2 games back, and enters on a one-game winning streak. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while New York's Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Bulls lost 1-3 to the Knicks in 2025-26, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3, 2026.
